title: Date Difference Calculator
description: Find the exact number of years, months, days, or total days between any two dates.

formula.summary: The gap between two dates is broken down using calendar-aware subtraction (matching how the Age Calculator works), plus a simple total-day count.
formula.expression: Difference = endDate − startDate, in years/months/days and total days

variables.meaning: The two dates being compared, in either order

examples.title: January 1 to December 31, 2024
examples.note: = 11 months, 30 days (365 total days, since 2024 is a leap year)

faqs.question: Does the order of the two dates matter?
faqs.answer: No - enter them in either order and the calculator automatically treats the earlier date as the start.

faqs.question: Does the result include both the start and end day?
faqs.answer: The total days figure counts the number of days between the two dates (an exclusive count), which is the standard way durations and date-math libraries report differences.

seoContent.heading: Common uses for a date difference calculator
seoContent.body: Calculating the span between two dates comes up constantly: figuring out project duration, contract length, time until a deadline, or how long ago a historical event occurred. This calculator gives both a human-readable years/months/days breakdown and precise total-day and total-week counts.

seoContent.heading: Calendar math vs. simple day counting
seoContent.body: Because months have different lengths, a 'months and days' breakdown requires walking the calendar rather than doing simple division. This calculator uses the same calendar-aware algorithm as the Age Calculator to guarantee an exact, correct breakdown regardless of which months or leap years fall in the range.
